text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"revise","checked":["intent_match","tradeoff_direction","knob_legality"],"critique":"Intent requires <=1.0 false alarms/hour. Proposed (transformer,w3,q0.9,p1) at default shows ~0.01/h, OK. But tradeoff_direction: q0.9 is very low (earlier) and persistence=1 is fastest; still OK. However policy justification claims “within ~1.0/h budget” without checking measured delay/false alarms at that exact operating point; also “safe supervised choice” ignores that unseen attacks may be missed—early detection intent is about speed, but must still meet budget. Revise to explicitly align with measured operating point and budget."}
